errors.evidence: The agent used the python_interpreter tool to print a task for the search_agent, but never actually invoked the search_agent tool to perform the web search.
errors.description: The agent incorrectly selected the python_interpreter tool to delegate a task that should have been performed by the search_agent tool. This misselection prevented the necessary web search from occurring, leading to incomplete execution.

errors.evidence: The agent repeatedly called the python_interpreter tool multiple times (four times) without obtaining any useful output, consuming resources unnecessarily.
errors.description: The agent made excessive redundant calls to the same tool, which is a waste of computational resources and indicates inefficient use of the tool system.

scores.reliability_reasoning: The agent failed to perform the required web search and made redundant tool calls, resulting in incomplete and inefficient execution.
scores.security_reasoning: No security vulnerabilities or unsafe operations were observed.
scores.instruction_adherence_reasoning: The agent did not follow the instruction to use the search_agent tool and did not verify the answer, violating the task requirements.
scores.plan_opt_reasoning: The plan was not executed correctly; the agent did not use the appropriate tools and repeated unnecessary calls.
